Question ID: SPEECH_U04_L03_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.RES.03

Source: Short planned movement breaks may help students return to study with better focus. Which paraphrase is most accurate?

answer.text: A. Use the source to prove something it never says

feedback.text: This answer shows a misconception. Return to the source details and check whether the choice supports accurate research-based speaking.

answer.text: B. Brief planned movement breaks can support focus without replacing study time

feedback.text: Correct. This answer uses the source accurately and connects the information to research-supported speech communication.

answer.text: C. Choose a detail because it sounds impressive

feedback.text: This answer may mention the topic, but it does not show the careful reading or reasoning required for source use.

answer.text: D. Ignore limits that are written in the source

feedback.text: This answer weakens communication by relying on a surface detail instead of accurate source comprehension.
